units.source_text: 太吉郎正要打盹儿，一个年轻的艺伎走进来，静静地坐了一会儿。

en.t: Taikichiro was just about to doze off when a young geisha came in and sat quietly for a while.

units.source_text: 初次见面的客人，也许是很难侍候的。

en.t: Perhaps a guest one is meeting for the first time is hard to entertain.

units.source_text: 太吉郎心不在焉，一点也提不起说话的兴趣来。

en.t: Taikichiro was distracted and could not summon the slightest interest in talking.

units.source_text: 艺伎也许是要逗引客人高兴，开口说：自从她出来当舞女，两年之内，她喜欢的男人就有四十七个。

en.t: Perhaps the geisha was trying to cheer her guest, for she began to say that in the two years since she had become a dancer, there had been forty-seven men she had liked.
